details.description: Qwen3-Embedding-4B is the mid-sized model in Alibaba's Qwen3 Embedding series, a text embedding model built on the Qwen3 foundation architecture with 36 transformer layers and roughly 4 billion parameters. It produces embeddings for retrieval, classification, clustering, and bitext mining, supports instruction-aware queries that Qwen reports typically improve results by 1% to 5%, and uses Matryoshka Representation Learning so output vectors can be truncated to smaller dimensions. Qwen states it supports over 100 languages, including programming languages, and it is released under the Apache 2.0 license.
advantages: Scores 69.45 on the MTEB Multilingual leaderboard, the second-highest score in Qwen's own Qwen3 Embedding series after the 8B model, per its Hugging Face model card.
Scores 74.60 on MTEB English v2 and 72.27 on C-MTEB (Chinese), per its Hugging Face model card.
Qwen reports that adding task-specific instructions to queries typically improves performance by 1% to 5% over not using instructions, per its Hugging Face model card.
Supports Matryoshka Representation Learning, allowing the 2,560-dimension output to be truncated down to 32 dimensions, per its Hugging Face model card.
disadvantages: Scores lower than the 8B variant in Qwen's own series on the MTEB multilingual leaderboard (69.45 vs. 70.58), per its Hugging Face model card.

sources.title: Qwen3 Embedding: Advancing Text Embedding and Reranking Through Foundation Models

notes: Only a language count ('over 100 languages') is given, not a list, so languages is left empty per the brief and the count is in the description instead. Context-length conflict: Qwen's own model card, the Qwen3 Embedding launch blog, and the GitHub README all state a 32K-token context for every size in this series, but Fireworks' hosted page for this specific model states a ~40.9k-token context, matching the catalog's 40,960 max_input/max_output facts. Kept the catalog's figure per instructions; flagging the maker/host disagreement here. No source found declaring this model deprecated or superseded within the Qwen3 Embedding line.
